claim: You can use IAM resource-based policies, which you create for your Amazon ECR repositories, to control and monitor who and what (for example, EC2 instances) can access your container images, and how, when and where they can access them.

evidence.quote: You can use IAM resource-based policies to control and monitor who and what (e.g., EC2 instances) can access your container images, as well as how, when, and where they can access them. To get started, use the AWS Management Console to create resource-based policies for your repositories.
